digest_queries: serving_state
SELECT key,value FROM catalog_meta WHERE key IN ('catalog_ready','content_scope','app_catalog_schema_version','graph_schema_version') ORDER BY key COLLATE BINARY
drug

SELECT id,region,source_id,license_no,name_zh,name_en,brand_name,dosage_form,spec,drug_category,license_holder,manufacturer,insurance_code,drug_code,active_ingredients,usage_ref_json,region_specific_json,aliases_json FROM drug ORDER BY id
drug_reference

SELECT reference_id,region,source_id,license_no,name_zh,name_en,brand_name,normalized_keys_json,spec_raw,spec_ref_json,source_fields_json,image_urls_json,match_status FROM drug_reference ORDER BY reference_id COLLATE BINARY
drug_detail
SELECT region,source_id,usage_text,indications,active_ingredients,usage_ref_json,raw_json FROM drug_detail ORDER BY region COLLATE BINARY,source_id COLLATE BINARY
hospital
SELECT rowid,region,source_id,code,name_zh,short_name,type_zh,level_zh,address,phone,admin_area,depts_json,aliases_json,match_status FROM hospital ORDER BY rowid
department
SELECT rowid,region,source_id,code,name_zh,category_zh,aliases_json,match_status FROM department ORDER BY rowid
diagnosis
SELECT rowid,region,source_id,code,name_zh,code_system,chapter_zh,aliases_json,match_status FROM diagnosis ORDER BY rowid
exam_item
SELECT rowid,region,source_id,code,name_zh,name_en,category,method,specimen,unit,price_ref,loinc_concept_id,aliases_json,match_status FROM exam_item ORDER BY rowid
entity
SELECT uid,kind,region,local_id,name FROM active_entity ORDER BY uid COLLATE BINARY
entity_state
SELECT s.entity_uid,s.training_subject FROM entity_state s JOIN active_entity e ON e.uid=s.entity_uid ORDER BY s.entity_uid COLLATE BINARY
drug_identity
SELECT d.entity_uid,d.kind,d.region,d.ingredient_text,d.dosage_form,d.strength_text FROM drug_identity d JOIN active_entity e ON e.uid=d.entity_uid ORDER BY d.entity_uid COLLATE BINARY
hospital_campus
SELECT h.entity_uid,h.kind,h.region,h.campus_name FROM hospital_campus h JOIN active_entity e ON e.uid=h.entity_uid ORDER BY h.entity_uid COLLATE BINARY
relation_rule
SELECT relation,subject_kind,object_kind FROM relation_rule ORDER BY relation COLLATE BINARY,subject_kind COLLATE BINARY,object_kind COLLATE BINARY
assertion

SELECT uid,subject_uid,subject_kind,object_uid,object_kind,region,relation,polarity,derivation,review_status,condition_text,condition_json,condition_status,qualifier_text,qualifier_json FROM active_assertion ORDER BY uid COLLATE BINARY
assertion_state
SELECT s.assertion_uid,s.source_record_uid FROM assertion_state s JOIN active_assertion a ON a.uid=s.assertion_uid ORDER BY s.assertion_uid COLLATE BINARY
assertion_review

SELECT r.assertion_uid,r.status,r.actor,r.rationale FROM current_assertion_review c JOIN assertion_review r ON r.review_uid=c.review_uid JOIN active_assertion a ON a.uid=c.assertion_uid ORDER BY r.assertion_uid COLLATE BINARY
assertion_evidence

SELECT ae.assertion_uid,ae.evidence_uid,ae.region,ae.role FROM assertion_evidence ae JOIN active_assertion a ON a.uid=ae.assertion_uid ORDER BY ae.assertion_uid COLLATE BINARY,ae.evidence_uid COLLATE BINARY,ae.role COLLATE BINARY
evidence

SELECT DISTINCT e.uid,e.document_uid,e.region,e.locator,e.full_text FROM evidence e JOIN assertion_evidence ae ON ae.evidence_uid=e.uid JOIN active_assertion a ON a.uid=ae.assertion_uid ORDER BY e.uid COLLATE BINARY
document
SELECT uid,source_uid,source_version,region,title,uri,full_text FROM active_document ORDER BY uid COLLATE BINARY
document_origin

SELECT o.document_uid,o.namespace,o.source_key,o.snapshot_id,o.payload_sha256,o.origin_kind FROM document_origin o JOIN active_document d ON d.uid=o.document_uid ORDER BY o.document_uid COLLATE BINARY
source
SELECT DISTINCT s.uid,s.name FROM source s JOIN active_document d ON d.source_uid=s.uid ORDER BY s.uid COLLATE BINARY
source_version

SELECT DISTINCT s.source_uid,s.version,s.region,s.status FROM source_version s JOIN active_document d ON d.source_uid=s.source_uid AND d.source_version=s.version ORDER BY s.source_uid COLLATE BINARY,s.version COLLATE BINARY
source_record
SELECT record_uid,source_uid,namespace,region,domain,source_key,entity_uid,current_document_uid FROM source_record WHERE active=1 ORDER BY record_uid COLLATE BINARY
alias
SELECT uid,entity_uid,region,text,status FROM active_alias ORDER BY uid COLLATE BINARY
catalog_entry
SELECT entry_uid,table_name,region,source_id,record_id,entity_uid,app_row_id,current_revision_uid FROM catalog_entry WHERE active=1 ORDER BY entry_uid COLLATE BINARY
catalog_revision

SELECT DISTINCT r.revision_uid,r.entry_uid,r.content_sha256,r.row_json,r.provenance_json FROM catalog_revision r JOIN catalog_entry c ON c.current_revision_uid=r.revision_uid AND c.active=1 ORDER BY r.revision_uid COLLATE BINARY
field_provenance

SELECT p.revision_uid,p.field_path,p.source_uid,p.document_uid,p.source_key,p.snapshot_id,p.role,p.locator_json FROM field_provenance p JOIN catalog_entry c ON c.current_revision_uid=p.revision_uid AND c.active=1 ORDER BY p.revision_uid COLLATE BINARY,p.field_path COLLATE BINARY,p.document_uid COLLATE BINARY,p.role COLLATE BINARY,p.locator_json COLLATE BINARY
catalog_relation
SELECT uid,subject_uid,predicate,object_uid,region,revision_uid,status FROM catalog_relation WHERE active=1 ORDER BY uid COLLATE BINARY
closure

SELECT c.scheme,c.version,c.ancestor_uid,c.descendant_uid,c.region,c.depth FROM closure c JOIN active_entity a ON a.uid=c.ancestor_uid JOIN active_entity d ON d.uid=c.descendant_uid ORDER BY c.scheme COLLATE BINARY,c.version COLLATE BINARY,c.ancestor_uid COLLATE BINARY,c.descendant_uid COLLATE BINARY
